hotspots.title: Rassemblement National’s Darmanin feud escalates
hotspots.blurb: France's far-right Rassemblement National (RN) intensifies calls for Interior Minister Gérald Darmanin's resignation over the Lyhanna case, exposing internal divisions between Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to its polarized contention, moral charge, and the high stakes of far-right influence in French politics.
